Container.Name: sheafly
Container.Overview: Sheafly is a self-hosted, Notion-style notes app with cloud sync across your devices, offline support (PWA) and instant full-text search. Create your account on first visit, then set "Allow sign-up" to false so nobody else can register. Installing it as an app on phones requires HTTPS, e.g. behind a reverse proxy or Tailscale.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database and signing key. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Allow sign-up
Config.Description: Set to false after creating your account. The first account can always be created.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when running behind a reverse proxy, so login rate limits use the real client IP.

Config.Name: Auth secret
Config.Description: Optional. Key for signing session tokens. Generated and stored in the data folder if empty.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data folder (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data folder (Unraid default: 100 = users).
